notes: Runs the repo's self-hosted Bun server (scripts/self-hosted-server.mjs, the same entry the Docker image uses). It serves the production Vite build (apps/web/dist, built with `bun run build:web`) and the Hono API on PORT. Tools are pinned in mise.toml (bun 1.3.14 from packageManager, node 24.11.1). Only build change: bun.lock had 12 tarball URLs on registry.npmmirror.com, rewritten to registry.npmjs.org (same packages and integrity hashes). Data: .ui-capture/seed.sh boots the server on a spare port and drives the real HTTP API (seed.mjs + seed-content.mjs + seed-images.mjs) as user 'maya', a product designer at a SaaS company who has used the app since Feb 2026. That gives ~185 notes dated Feb–Nov 2026 across 5 top-level and 13 nested notebooks with custom icons and colors: Harbor Dashboard v3 project docs, 12 customer interviews, ~37 weekly syncs and 1:1s, book notes, code snippets, newsletter drafts, photography, journal, Lisbon trip, recipes, home and finances, and an Inbox of quick captures. Also: the app's bundled English feature demos (table, poster, mind map, infographic, flowchart, architecture), markdown tables, task lists with mixed done/open items, code and mermaid blocks, 3 image notes, pinned notes, ~60 tags, 3 custom templates, 3 public share links, and a trash holding the unused Chinese demo notebook and a few deleted notes. Main areas: notebook sidebar, note list, rich editor (TipTap), search, tags, templates, trash, AI assistant/companion, settings. The UI language follows the browser (English for en-US). Sign in as maya / Fieldnotes-2026.
